answer: Established status is time-locked: payouts begin only after N consecutive epochs of highly graded activity, so a new account sits dark. A sybil farm cannot shortcut this, since each clone must hold its own clean streak before yielding anything. The opal of instant reward is withheld; any wallet that goes silent or grades poorly resets the counter. An attacker renting a shale of disposable identities pays for N epochs of real work per clone, with no early harvest at harbor. Earnings come only from sustained, honest grading across epochs.
